name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 17 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it on 30 Apr 2026 (MI5; Home Office, 1 May). Searches on 17 Nov found no announced change to the level.
for_you: Severe is a national assessment, not a warning about a specific place or date. MI5 and police advise staying alert and reporting anything suspicious to police, or 999 in an emergency.
rubric_hit: MI5/JTAC national threat level Severe = Alert
